title: 5 Accused Police Impersonators Get Arrested by Real Cops — Caught On Bodycam
description:
The process to become a police officer or Sheriff's deputy varies from state to state. From passing numerous exams and a lengthy interview process to physical tests and completing the academy, active law enforcement have earned their badge. However, there are people who think they can bypass that process by purchasing their own uniforms and police equipment before hitting the streets to roleplay as cops. Watch five times accused police impersonators were caught on bodycam and arrested by the real police.
